verdict.rationale: Clerk's eve tool-call authorization guide says it can "broker OAuth for tools that need a provider token on the caller's behalf," a first-party claim that matches the core of delegated third-party tokens for agent tool calls. That claim is a single line, with no detail on how it works. missing for 10: documentation of the user-consent flow, evidence that brokered tokens are short-lived or refreshed, details of token vault storage or exchange, a list of supported third-party providers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
